notes.subject: כמגדלות
notes.rationale: Tanim tok i makim: 'olsem ol tua' (migdalot) o 'ol tua bilong em' (banis bilong ples); KJV 'like towers'.

notes.subject: gutpela taim
notes.rationale: שלום i min gutpela taim / olgeta i stap orait, i no wankain 'favour' olsem KJV.

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Pronaun bilong man — pronaun prefiks -ו long בעיניו i stap, tasol Tok Pisin i needim tok ⟨em⟩.

notes.subject: to the man she loves
notes.rationale: Meri i tokim man bilong en — 'long ai bilong em'.

translation: Mi em banis, na susu bilong mi olsem ol tua; bihain mi kamap long ai bilong ⟨em⟩ olsem wanpela i painim gutpela taim.
